reuse.why: The change reuses findOrCreateBank and syncAccount and shares validation and unlink cleanup across providers, but copies the provider linking and download workflows.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the existing account creation/update/import workflow and the Akahu transaction download workflow.

placement.why: Handlers, transaction downloads, endpoint configuration and provider types remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: All edits support the requested linking rules, takeover option or server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and cleanup simplify future rule changes, but duplicated provider workflows increase the number of places maintainers must update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared validation and replacement helpers, and Fintegra uses the existing bank lookup and sync abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount repeats the SimpleFin/Akahu linking workflow under Fintegra names, while downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions with endpoint/log substitutions and a reshaped retVal declaration.

abstraction_drift.where: Across the requested steps, assertBankAccountCanBeLinked gains replaceExistingLink, a closed-target refusal branch and a replacement exception to duplicate-link refusal; all six handlers continue using it.
